name: Almanac
description: Every FBS team, roster and player in one place. Browse by conference, open a school for its roster and season, then open a player for his career stats and the high-school class he came out of. Includes a recruiting board and a transfer-portal tracker. Data comes from CollegeFootballData on a scheduled, budget-aware sync — no page ever waits on an outbound call.
author: Ernest Defoe
